title: First jobs on his father's small carnival
summary: His first job was with his father on a gilly show, explained as a small carnival moving by boxcar; he stayed with his father through high school.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: I can see you really have played a variety of jobs what was your very first job?
it was with my father on a small carnival what we call a a ghillie show
what's a ghillie show? I never heard of that
well that's a carnival talk for a small carnival that doesn't have cars of its own it just loads up in a couple of box cars and moves on to the next town
and then what was your next job?
on with another band not your father's?
no with my father I stayed with my father or practical till I finished high school off and on sometimes I left and did other things but usually I was with my father
